blocks.text: 你可以使用 Stop hook 让 Claude 在检查失败时重试，但一定要确保它以退出码 2 退出！

inlines.text: 你可以使用 Stop hook 让 Claude 在检查失败时重试，但一定要确保它以退出码 2 退出！

blocks.text: 退出码 2 会把 Claude 送回重试，并带上该 hook 的 stderr；退出码 1 是非阻塞的，所以即使检查失败，Claude 也只会直接结束

inlines.text: 退出码 2 会把 Claude 送回重试，并带上该 hook 的 stderr；退出码 1 是非阻塞的，所以即使检查失败，Claude 也只会直接结束

blocks.text: You can use a Stop hook to have Claude try again when a check fails, but make sure it exits with code 2!

inlines.text: You can use a Stop hook to have Claude try again when a check fails, but make sure it exits with code 2!

blocks.text: Exit 2 sends Claude back to retry with the hook's stderr, exit 1 is non-blocking so Claude just finishes even when the check failed

inlines.text: Exit 2 sends Claude back to retry with the hook's stderr, exit 1 is non-blocking so Claude just finishes even when the check failed
